description: Connect Nimbata call tracking to a business's line. connect {api_token} checks and saves a Nimbata personal API token (Agency plan; one token can serve many businesses). link_project {project_id, target_business_id?} attaches that Nimbata project's calls to a business and adds KaiCalls tags to the project: calls Kai answers get Nimbata's source, UTM and click ids, and Kai's outcome is written back to the Nimbata call as a KaiCalls tag, a KaiCalls qualified tag when Kai qualified the caller, and a summary comment. unlink_project {link_id}; set_writeback {enabled}; disconnect. Requires current admin role on every business involved. Routing stays in Nimbata: add the KaiCalls number to the project's call flow there.
name: manage_nimbata
title: Set up Nimbata
